crossRefs.note: Behold, Yahweh’s eye is on those who fear him, on those who hope in his loving kindness,
Now let those who fear Yahweh say that his loving kindness endures forever.
Yahweh takes pleasure in those who fear him, in those who hope in his loving kindness.
In the fear of Yahweh is a secure fortress, and he will be a refuge for his children.
“Every word of God is flawless. He is a shield to those who take refuge in him.
but in every nation he who fears him and works righteousness is acceptable to him.

translations.web: You who fear Yahweh, trust in Yahweh! He is their help and their shield.
translations.bsb: You who fear the LORD, trust in the LORD! He is their help and shield.
translations.kjv: Ye that fear the LORD, trust in the LORD: he is their help and their shield.
translations.asv: Ye that fear Jehovah, trust in Jehovah: He is their help and their shield.
